quotes.text: We believe AI can contribute to productivity and economic gains, but also help us identify waste and fraud. We have to take action when we have identified it.

One of the attractive qualities of West Texas for these data centers and AI facilities is that we are energy-rich, [...] If they can tap the energy around us, both fossil and renewable, it's going to be able to support the advancements in AI, America's leadership in AI, and all the value that AI brings to our economy by making industries and our economy more efficient.

Artificial Intelligence has the potential to revolutionize how the federal government spends and saves American taxpayer dollars and to help our economy grow faster. The House Budget Committee is leading the charge in assessing any and all technological innovations that can help us reduce the deficit and right our fiscal ship.

I am proud to welcome Sam Altman and the teams from OpenAI and Oracle to ‘Silicon Prairie’ as we launch the future of American innovation right here in West Texas, [...] From construction jobs to cutting-edge careers, this project means opportunities for our people, billions in private investment, and a powerful reminder that America - not China - will lead in the technologies of tomorrow. West Texas has always been the backbone of our nation’s food security and was at the forefront of the energy revolution - now we’re powering the next frontier of information technology.

There's no better place to build the backbone for AI than West Texas because of our abundant and reliable energy, our workforce, our hard-working, God fearing, freedom-loving people, and we have a very good environment for starting businesses and building facilities like this at this scale,

I'm very proud that West Texas is now not only the food, fuel and fiber capital of the world, where we have energy and agriculture dominance, but we're the new frontier for information technology and in support of the AI race for our great country,
Erring on the side of innovation and winning the race is the right initial posture,
If that’s the game we’re going to play, we will lose. Managing the risk responsibly, that’s right on. Winning the race, I think, is an imperative.
